comment: The DESIGN.md 4.3 worked mapping (the 8 ms optimum for chain at 160 B), bound to the scenario that reads the real GGML export. It is byte-identical to examples/chain.mapping.json on purpose: the same action list has to be legal and optimal for both, which is the sharpest statement that the export and the fixture describe the same workload. Hand-written, so it carries no fingerprints and replays as fingerprint_verified=false.
